GOVERNMENT OF PUNJAB
DEPARTMENT OF WATER RESOURCES
NOTIFICATION
The 23rd October, 2025
No.WR-IRWR04/37/2023-IW3/2286.- In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 38 of Punjab
Canal and Drainage Act, 2023, read with Section 2 of the aforesaid Act, the Governor of Punjab is pleased to
notify the Khasra numbers as per details given below for the smooth flow of Water in River Ghaggar.
The Governor of Punjab is further pleased to authorize the Executive Engineer, Mansa, Drainage-cum-
Mining Division, WRD, Punjab, District Mansa, to take all necessary to remove obstructions, in case any such
obstructions are raised by any person. The Concerned officer i.e., Executive Engineer, Mansa, Drainage-cum-
Mining Division, WRD, Punjab, District Mansa, may also authorize any other Government officer or any
private person to remove such obstructions or carry out any activities for the aforesaid purpose.
